title: Common scalar definitions
description: Canonical scalar rules shared by every contract in this package. See README.md section 1.

decimal-string.description: Decimal-safe amount, price, quantity, rate, or FX value. Never binary floating point at an external boundary. NaN, Infinity, and negative zero are invalid.

utc-timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with nanosecond capability. Provider/exchange-local timezone metadata is preserved separately, not encoded here.

schema-version.description: Semantic version of this record's schema.

opaque-id.description: Opaque, stable identifier. Never a display symbol or human-readable name used as sole identity.

extensible-enum.description: Convention: every enum in this package includes 'unknown' and 'other' so unrecognized provider codes round-trip safely instead of failing closed on parse.
